about: Deliberate divergences the weekly knowledge lint must not report (tools/knowledge-lint.ts and knowledge-lint-compare.ts). Brad owns this file: the loop proposes entries in its report and never edits it. Each entry: rule, then handle (one entry) or pair (two handles, any order; the algorithm is algorithm:<topic>), optional item (the finding's exact item; without it the entry covers the whole handle or pair), reason, date (YYYY-MM-DD), who. For the model rules an entry with an item is shown to the model as a known divergence; one without an item skips the comparison.

entries.reason: Deliberate: the algorithm's LDL target (below 1.4 mmol/L, 55 mg/dL) sits below guideline targets.
